key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
source:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Dali nga pagsugod
1. I-install ang Torque Pro (ang bayad nga bersiyon; ang Torque Lite dili mosuporta og mga plugin) ug ipares ang imong OBD-II adapter.
2. I-on kini nga plugin sa Torque → Mga setting → Mga plugin.
3. Tugoti ang mga pahibalo, ug ibutang ang paggamit sa baterya sa Walay utlanan aron masugdan sa Torque kini nga plugin sa luyo.
4. Sa Torque, pilia ang profile sa sakyanan sa awto nga imong gimaneho. Ang datos gitipigan matag profile sa Torque ug gitandi sa identidad nga VIN/ECU sa sakyanan.
5. Sa bag-ong profile, ang tinubdan sa sugnod mamatikdan kung magkonektar ka; kung pangutan-on, itandi kini sa gauge sa dashboard dayon pindota ang Kumpirma. Ang Kumpirma anaa sa panid sa setup ug sa pahibalo. Mahimo usab nimo kining pilion sa ubos.
6. Walay gidak-on sa tangke nga isulod dinhi. Ang matag pagkasibo makakat-on sa iyang kaugalingong gidak-on, gipakita ubos sa Nakat-unan nga gidak-on sa tangke; hangtod niana ang gitul-id nga porsiyento mobasa og 1:1 sa gauge. Isulod ang gidak-on sa tangke sa profile sa sakyanan sa Torque para sa nahibilin nga sugnod ug DTE sa Torque mismo.
7. Sa Torque, idugang ang mga gauge alang sa [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level ug, alang sa matag pagkasibo, Corrected % ug Tank size. Ang plugin dili magpatik sa nahibilin nga sugnod o DTE. Usa ka pahibalo samtang nag-refit nag-ingon nga kana nga pagkasibo mobasa og 1:1 hangtod mahuman ang refit.
8. Ibalik ang lebel sa sugnod ngadto sa Torque: Palong, Hinapsay, o Gitul-id gikan sa pagkasibo sa Chunk, Band o Kalman ngadto sa imong 012F gauge. Ang nahibilin nga sugnod ug DTE sa Torque mismo mogamit niana nga lebel uban sa gidak-on sa tangke ug sa long-term nga mpg sa profile sa Torque.
9. Ang sugnod iihap lamang samtang nagdagan ang makina. Ang plugin modagan lamang samtang ang Torque konektado sa ECU.
10. Padayon sa pagdrayb ug pagpuno; ang katukma motubo sa daghang partial nga tangke. Kung ang plugin dili makasulti unsang sakyanan kini, mangutana kini sa pahibalo ug niining panid; pilia kung unsa ang buhaton niana nga biyahe.
11. Ang tanang datos magpabilin niini nga telepono. Walay GPS o lokasyon nga marekord.
